pokedexEntries.rb: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

pokedexEntries.ye: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.

pokedexEntries.go: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

pokedexEntries.si: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

pokedexEntries.cr: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

pokedexEntries.ru: ELECTRODE eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this POKéMON exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.

pokedexEntries.sa: One of ELECTRODE’s characteristics is its attraction to electricity. It is a problematical POKéMON that congregates mostly at electrical power plants to feed on electricity that has just been generated.

pokedexEntries.fr: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”

pokedexEntries.lg: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

pokedexEntries.em: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
